Hi Emma and team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — excited to get LarkTech into our Dedicated tier. Per our contract, we need to align the initial onboarding responsibilities and a short implementation checklist so CS can begin scheduling workstreams next Monday.

Quick summary for context (high level):
- SKU: Dedicated 2xA100 (reserved) + burst pool for peak inference (monthly commit).
- Key success metric: API p95 latency < 220ms at 50 RPS for inference route; first evaluation window 30 days post-golive.
- Data residency: US (VA region).

Asks / open items for CS to triage:
1) Final SSO / IdP decision (SAML vs OIDC) and provisioning contacts.
2) Network egress IP allowlist window — LarkTech infra team needs the list and the desired cutover date.
3) Confirmation on whether you want prefix-level KV caching enabled initially (saves cost for deterministic prompts, but requires a short schema review).

I've attached the latest SOW (Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf) and the network requirements workbook; the procurement mailbox was looped earlier for PO questions.

Next steps I propose internally: assign a CS owner and schedule a 60-minute kickoff with engineering + security to confirm SSO and network. Ben/Marissa — can one of you take ownership? If not, I can route to Tessa for staffing.

Emma — would morning PT on 5/20 for the kickoff work for you and your infra lead?

Thanks,
Jonas

--

- SSO: We will go with the customer's central IdP and prefer SAML for now. I'll send the SAML metadata by EOD Friday (5/17). Point of contact: Marco Diaz (marco.diaz@larktech.com).
- Network: We prefer a maintenance window during the week of 5/20; our infra can be available 5/22 in the morning PT.
- KV caching: Sounds useful. We default to keeping prompt outputs opaque, so if there are schema questions we can review with your CS.

We did forward SOW to procurement; sending a couple of contract clarifications (term language) back today — expect a redline from procurement@larktech.com.

Morning PT on 5/20 is tight for us — 5/22 10:00 PT works better.
